user_query: I'm a music blogger and I'm looking for unique and lesser-known indie songs to feature on my blog. Can you provide me with the top 50 indie songs and their daily stream increase data? Additionally, suggest some interesting facts about the artists behind these songs.

TaskList.description: Fetch the list of top 50 unique and lesser-known indie songs.
Retrieve daily stream increase data for the top 50 indie songs obtained from step 1.
Gather interesting facts about the artists behind the top 50 indie songs.
